## Key Verified Entities
- Hotel Shadab (Charminar): Mutton Dum Biryani, Tala Hua Ghost, Qubani Ka Meetha. Rated 4.0★ (90k+ reviews).
- Cafe Niloufer (Himayatnagar/Hitec): Special Irani Chai, Maska Bun, Osmania Biscuits. Open until 1:30 AM.
- Ishtaa (HITEC City): Premium pure veg South Indian tiffins with multi-chutney spread.
- Penam (Jubilee Hills): Homestyle village-style dosas and pungaralu with fresh chutney.
- Panchakattu Dosa (Begumpet/Nallagandla): Spicy Rayalaseema Ghee Karam Dosa.
- Roastery Coffee House (Banjara Hills): Lush garden bungalow, Cascara, Cranberry Cold Brew, specialty pourovers.
- Conçu (Jubilee Hills/Begumpet): Masterclass French pastry, Banoffee tart, Opera, Choux buns.
- Famous Ice Cream (Mozamjahi Market): 1951 heritage hand-churned fruit pot ice cream (Sitaphal, Mango, Sapota).
- Milano Ice Cream (Jubilee Hills): Authentic Italian artisan gelato (Pistachio, Dark Chocolate).
- Cream Stone (Citywide): Late-night cold-stone sundaes (Willy Wonka, Devil's Brownie) open till 2 AM.
- The Nawaabs (Gachibowli): Tender Mutton Dum Biryani in Cyberabad.
- Roast 24 Seven (Jubilee Hills/Gachibowli): 24/7 specialty coffee and work cafe.
- DLF Street Food (Gachibowli): Midnight food hub open until 3:00 AM (Jai Bhawani tiffins, momos, Maggi).
